lines.t: Yeah, yeah, I've been running from the truth too long
Now I'm done, let's go
Yeah, woke up with my heart still heavy
Passed on my bag like a load I carry
Used to blame God when my soul felt empty
Now I talk to him daily, he defends me
Life hit hard, yeah, cut like glass
Tryna find peace in a whiskey glass
Now I'm seeing clear, no smoke, no mask
Every scar I got, got a purpose at last
Used to curse in the mirror
Now I'm speaking scripture clearer
Grace don't come cheap
But the blood paid the price, now the way's nearer
You broke the chain
I'm free again
Every wound you turn to strength within
And when I fall, you call my name Yeah, I rise to the pain, you broke the chain
Yeah, yeah, I was angry, lost and cold Heart made of stone, no hand to hold
Had a voice in my head saying, you'll never change
But your love rearranged everything I became Now I stand on the world like a solid foundation
No more fear, no hesitation, enemies lurk Temptation loud, but I walk through the storm with a face so proud
This ain't religion, it's redemption song A prodigal kid who's been gone too long
You took the hate and turned it to flame Now every verse I spit just praises your name
Every time I stumble, you lift me higher Turning my guilt into holy fire
No more chains, no more pain Just freedom in the blood that breaks every chain
You broke the chain, I'm free again Every wound you turn to strength within
When I fall, you call my name Yeah, I rise to the pain, you broke the chain
Hands to the sky, I'm not the same No fear remains, you broke the chain
You broke the chain
